title: When the Signal Burns
author: Yara Almeida
blurb: Dominic Kavanagh, an insurance investigator of impossible accidents, has spent three years hauling cargo through contested orbits. But when an unfamiliar name shows up on the manifest of a ship that never flew, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now she must keep a lie alive that holds two fleets apart, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
